title: Cosmic Egg Dreamscape
description: A surreal night scene shows a large iridescent egg resting on a black dripping platform in a flower-filled meadow. Multicolored swirling streams of light and stars flow upward from the egg and a visible human hand toward a red barn and starry sky filled with yellow and blue nebulae.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene in a misty meadow with wildflowers and broken fence posts. A giant iridescent egg sits on a black melting platform dripping colorful liquid. A human hand emerges from swirling multicolored streams of stars, smoke and light that flow upward into a cosmic sky filled with yellow and blue nebulae. Red wooden barn stands in the background. Decorative organic border with vines and flowers. Whimsical psychedelic style with visible brushwork.
